tool.name: Llama 3 (8B)
tool.summary: Meta's compact open-weights model designed to run efficiently on consumer hardware while retaining strong instruction-following capabilities.
tool.architecture: Transformer decoder with grouped query attention trained on 15T tokens.
tool.usage:
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct")
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct")
tool.limitations: Less capable than larger models, struggles with complex multi-step reasoning.
